scope.world_frequencies: strictly positive but arbitrarily redistributable within each target class

finite_sharp_envelope.attainment: supremum over strictly positive world frequencies; binary one-pure-root chain or ternary two-pure-root rare-mixed chain with private-pair fixed mandates

independent_small_exhaustive.enumeration: all nonconstant query outcome patterns, all unordered pairs of distinct queries, all nonconstant target label assignments, all pairs of one target-0 and one target-1 world carrying limiting probability 0.5 each, both query orders
independent_small_exhaustive.comparison: agreement to numerical precision; enumeration performed independently of repository policy solver

ternary_constructive_task.early_pure_leaves: opposite target classes, each with encounter probability 0.49

finite_canonical.conclusion: Binary cannot repay K=0.62 under 50:50 target prevalence at n=10,m=9, while a concrete ternary policy can.

claim_ceiling: Not an empirical evolutionary result; outcome cardinality carries unit acquisition cost, arity-specific hardware costs are not modeled, and all envelope attainments optimize within-target world frequencies. New theorem remains supplementary pending latest CI and prior-art review.

exact_ternary_only_target_prevalence_win.interpretation: In this finite idealized model, ternary is needed only when the two target classes are sufficiently balanced. Binary existence returns when one target class exceeds about 72.08% encounter prevalence.
assumptions: unit query acquisition costs independent of outcome cardinality
within-target world probabilities may be redistributed
not a claim about sensory receptor count or empirical mosquito fitness

ternary_capacity_premium_overhead_sensit.scope: difference of two class-specific supremal capacities, not within-environment genotype selection
ternary_capacity_premium_overhead_sensit.interpretation: Even when ternary class has higher capacity, arity-specific overhead can eliminate the advantage; this is a cross-task-class bound, not a selection coefficient.

matched_world_architecture_comparison.validation_method: Independent exhaustive recursion over allowed query orders and outcomes, plus repository regression test
matched_world_architecture_comparison.claim_ceiling: Pairwise advantage only for the specified same-world different-vocabulary architectures, not universal evolutionary preference for ternary cues or empirical evidence.

query_budget_endpoint_audit.observation: M3=M, so the ternary-class capacity exceeds the binary-class capacity for all target prevalences p strictly between 0 and 1.
